_README: TEMPLATE — NOT A LIVE MANIFEST. Fields marked FILL_AFTER_UPLOAD are empty by design.
This is the Arweave path-manifest shape (application/x.arweave-manifest+json) plus an
HFO integrity sidecar. ONE txid resolves every path below — that mechanism is what makes
'one address unfolds into the grimoire' literal rather than metaphorical.
Digests were recomputed from disk at hfo.valid_time_utc. Do NOT trust them at upload time:
recompute (norm N5 — a number read back from a document is not evidence).
NOTHING HERE IS AUTHORIZED FOR UPLOAD. See UPLOAD_PLAN.md §6 and SIGN_HERE.md.

hfo.canon_rule: strip BOM; CRLF/CR -> LF; exactly one terminal LF; self_hash VALUE replaced with the literal token SELF_HASH_PLACEHOLDER

hfo.sha256_note: raw == canon: this file has no self_hash field and is already LF-normalized with one terminal LF. Digest is of the SCAFFOLD (empty body) and WILL change when the operator writes it. RECOMPUTE at upload.
hfo.block_reason: The operator writes this body. An agent filling it forges the artifact the generation exists to preserve. DO NOT UPLOAD EMPTY — Arweave has no edit.

hfo.note: v0_SEED. Superseded by 1a2349b42164b58d… (v1.0.1, gen-132-era, located in the directory named hfo_gen_131_forge) and then by 83b09f1e1009135e… (gen-133 v1.1.0). Label it superseded in the manifest or a reader will mistake it for current.

hfo.block_reason: Spell selection is operator-only. An agent does not know which incantations are load-bearing.

hfo.authorization_note: NONE. Operator-typed only. An agent may stage; an agent may not fire.

bundle.size_bound_reason: ArDrive Turbo free tier historically covers <100 KiB. UNVERIFIED — confirm live at upload.

signature.note: Private half must be generated and held OUTSIDE the agent trust domain. An agent-generated signature proves only that something with access to the agent's process signed it — which is exactly what the signature must rule out. A4 stays OPEN until then.

hfo.honest_flaw: Two of the five payload paths are empty slots (operator soul body, spells). Uploading now would permanently anchor an empty grimoire, and Arweave offers no correction — only a second address, which violates standing decision D5 (ONE address). Cost and gateway behavior are UNVERIFIED: no network call was authorized to this lane.
